title: Wso2am: authenticated attacker could exceed the session flow control incoming window potentially leading to denial of…
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package allows an authenticated attacker to exceed the session flow control incoming window, which can lead to denial of service. This issue affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5. A patch is available in versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4.
